description: This file defines a custom exception class `ServerErrorException` that indicates server errors occurring during service invocation within the Eclipse Hono client. It extends `ServiceInvocationException` and enforces that error codes are within the 500-599 range.

classes.name: ServerErrorException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing server errors during service invocation, with error codes restricted to the 500-599 range.
